portlight.state: Input and 369-line implementation prototype read in full by root; final nine-file package remains in production.
portlight.policy_space: 18 supplied policies: bank equity 0/10/20 H, prepositioned foreign cash 0/5/10 F, pension grant 0/2 H.
portlight.objective: Minimize gross sponsor cash b+z across policies satisfying every listed scenario; lower f breaks a tie. This is a restricted decision objective, not a welfare or total economic-cost optimum.
portlight.feasibility: Actual bank and pension obligations paid at their stipulated cutoffs; home cash >=2 and marked bank equity >=20 at first home-payment close and final close. These are fictional board limits. Reserves never take payment priority over real creditors.
portlight.execution: Execute capped partial payments, preserve unpaid claims and earlier deadline failures, track separately pledged bond units, expense funding interest, and release collateral only after full repayment. Impaired carrying assets and surviving nominal borrower arrears are separate.
portlight.funding: Separate endowed sponsor, FX dealer, secured lender and collateral buyer. Exogenous bill, borrower operating and foreign-issuer receipts require explicit payer/date/funding assumptions. Do not claim whole-economy conservation beyond the included ledgers.
portlight.necessity: Joint-state zero early FX capacity requires f>=9, hence f=10 in the menu. With b=10, maximum secured capacity 20/3 cannot meet first home payment and reserve. Thus b=20. Pension initial cash 1 plus its maximum bank claim 12 requires z=2 for benefits 15. The selected policy satisfies all three states.
portlight.risk: Capital-flow-adjusted losses are 0, 127/10 and 1094/45 H with stipulated physical probabilities 1/2, 1/3 and 1/6. VaR75=127/10 and ES75=5519/270, taking all joint-state mass and 1/12 of credit-state probability. Physical weights do not price the bond.
portlight.reverse: Holding every other contract fixed and using q=(1+y)^(-2) at fixed remaining maturity, funding needs q>=4/15, while the capital floor only needs q>=3/50. Equality at y=sqrt(15)/2-1 is feasible; final equity there is 362/15. Contractual cutoffs are not elapsed years.
portlight.limits: Prototype review and supplied-menu proof only. Final manuscript, code changes, full prompt/solution review, portable execution, malformed-input handling, source scope and separate peer review remain required.
